title: Build a Dream House Together
outcome: Child designs and builds their own small house over one or two sessions - choosing shape, colors, door/window placement, and at least one surprise feature - with the mentor building only supporting parts the child assigns.
multiplayerRequirements: Shared-world variant uses adult-owned Realm; mentor has build permission but defers to child's plan.
knownIncompatibilities: None specific; creative mode identical across Bedrock platforms

guardianSteps: Optional: child can bring a drawing or toy as inspiration
mentorPreflight: Flat build plot reserved near spawn in BB Starter Plains
Hotbar pre-fill NOT done - child picks own blocks
If session 2 of this module: load saved world and locate child's in-progress house

mentorMoves: Ask about any new build ideas since last time
Ask 'What makes a house YOURS?' Offer bounded choices if stuck: tall tower / wide cottage / secret underground
flow.childAction: Describes or picks their dream house style

mentorMoves: Guide placing the front door first - instant house feeling!
flow.childAction: Places a door on empty ground

mentorMoves: Demo ONE technique they'll need: stacking walls, or making a window gap
Ask where walls should go before they place them
Ask 'what goes here?' not 'put it here'
Take only assigned helper tasks (e.g., gathering more wool)
flow.childAction: Builds walls, roof starts, decorates interior

mentorMoves: Offer one upgrade choice: secret room, garden, balcony...
Record continuation: finish roof? furnish? garden?

openingLines: Today you're the architect! What does your dream house look like?
Ready to build something totally YOURS?
keyPhrases: Should I help with that part or is it yours?
What's this room going to be?

learnerCues.cueText: Put your door where you want it!

sharedRoles.mentorRole: Construction Helper - builds ONLY what child assigns; gathers materials on request
sharedRoles.rotationNotes: Small groups (2-3 children): each builds own house on adjacent plots; may trade helper roles

commonProblems.fix: Mentor offers 3 simple roof styles (flat, triangle stairs, pyramid); child picks and tries
Normalize: builders change plans! Offer to knock down just one wall rather than restart everything
Self-check: pause and ask 'whose house is this?' - return control immediately

hintLadder: Where do you want the door?
Try standing inside your walls and looking around - what's missing?
Want me to show you how stairs make a pointy roof? Or we can do flat!
resetPath: Creative mode: no damage possible. If build collapses badly, mentor restores plot from world backup copy; child's placed door and chosen blocks list are preserved as the 'plan'.
soloFallback: Fully works solo-guided via screen-share; mentor acts as remote construction helper by voice only.
accessibilityOptions: Auto-jump ON for climbing scaffolding-like moments
One-wall-per-session pacing available across two sessions
Mentor handles high/dangerous-feeling placements on request WITHOUT taking over design
safetyRequirements: Private world or adult-owned Realm; no public servers
Shared-world variant: mentor permissions limited to build/break in designated plot area
parentSummaryTemplate: {child} designed and built their own dream house called '{houseName}' today! They chose every color and added {feature}. Ask them for the tour next time you're together.

review.notes: Needs playtest especially on touch-device block placement precision.

worldSpecification.description: BB Starter Plains with marked 12x12 build plots near spawn; each child gets one plot.
